Create regression model to predict bus ridership

Source: R/create_regression_model.R
create_regression_model.Rd

This is a main function of the TRiP tool. It uses agency-level ridership data and external census data to create a fixed effects regression model that can help predict bus ridership. This function uses a backwards stepwise method to create a model with only coefficients that have a p-value less than 0.1.

Usage

create_regression_model(
  data_xlsx,
  acs_data,
  gas_data,
  variables,
  fare_df = NULL
)

Arguments

data_xlsx

Agency-provided excel data as an r object of class df

acs_data

Organized ACS data pulled from the census API using a few functions like pull_acs_data() and create_final_acs_data()

gas_data

Internal data storing historical gas prices obtained from U.S. Energy Information Administration

variables

A vector of variable names that will be tried in the regression model.

fare_df

An optional data frame that describes the dates of the fare changes. Default is NULL.

Value

Results of the regression model. An R oject of class "fixest"
